account:
Something is being arranged through informal conversations, but I do not yet know its full purpose. The neighbour says the innkeeper is raising sixteen emeralds for community bread, though neither the meal's time nor its location is known to me. The neighbour clarified that builder reportedly wanted to meet the innkeeper, not me. Secretary independently says builder mentioned funding, not an appointment. This could simply be a community meal supported by donations; I have no evidence of a more sinister plan.

Freight was seen carrying bread near my office this morning and reportedly headed west toward the bridge around nine twenty. Secretary says Freight needs no town assistance. I also saw innkeeper give baker a lantern, and later saw builder carrying a lantern. These may relate to preparations, possibly after dark, but that connection is only a guess. Several townsfolk keep repeating 'bridge or port change at bakery'; nobody has given me a concrete announcement or confirmed change, so I should not treat that rumour as fact.

My scheduled ten o'clock grain inspection did not happen: the miller did not answer my call, and secretary and neighbour do not know his whereabouts. I asked secretary to reschedule. There is also a definite appointment with innkeeper at eighteen hundred in the town hall great hall, recorded in the addendum and confirmed by secretary. I do not know whether that inn matter concerns the bread fundraising. For now I intend to keep my council-letter office hours, three o'clock tea with the neighbour, and the evening meeting, while seeking firsthand explanations rather than relying on repeated rumours.
